title: Prove the sharp physical prefix range on the role-1256 graph
body:
## Summary

The sharp physical component range of an ordered prefix on one nine-axis tile of the role-1256 graph is **51,863,149/8**. This is a scoped proof with a finite certificate. It covers independent real and imaginary entrance components in $[-1,1]$. The real output at address zero attains the bound after donor 103886, the eleventh term of row 156140 in chart 127. [Proof](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d88ecbf3dffa8a2386c90766829b769dd8068a1f/research/relay1256-physical-prefix-range/README.md) · [Receipt](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d88ecbf3dffa8a2386c90766829b769dd8068a1f/research/relay1256-physical-prefix-range/RESULT.json)

For each entrance, sum its signed scalar contributions, take the absolute value, and multiply by its chart gain $2^{\lceil d/2\rceil}$ at Fourier rank $d$. The scalar maximum from #7709 times the worst nine-axis gain gives $53{,}895{,}757/8$. Keeping the individual chart gains tightens that ceiling by 254,076.

## Evidence and reproduction

The checker visited 172,414 prefixes in 7,644 rows. A backward rational expansion of the winning prefix agreed on all 448 nonzero entrance coefficients. Evaluating exact adjoint frame rows gave the attaining physical signs. aliromman posed the chart question and supplied the normalized prefix method. Clear1nsight provided the graph and physical chart contract from SYLforge's parent word. [Original claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19714961)

From the repository root, these commands ran locally on arm64 macOS with CPython 3.12.15. The standalone verifier took 1.71 seconds and the package replay took 2.07 seconds.

```sh
PYTHON=python3.12
PKG=research/relay1256-physical-prefix-range
"$PYTHON" -I -W error -B "$PKG/verify.py"
"$PYTHON" -B scripts/research_package.py --package "$PKG"
"$PYTHON" -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package "$PKG" --check-source-history --check-modes
```

The runs returned `PASS_RELAY1256_PHYSICAL_PREFIX`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`. The final check covered 19 files, their committed bytes and executable modes, and base ancestry. The reproduction commands accept any CPython 3.12 executable.

## Limits

The proof covers exact row accumulators on a single forward tile. Active tensor repetitions, paid-child interiors, numerator temporaries, rounding, correlated caller inputs and a complete root-width budget remain open. The selected cold replay, full predecessor suites and formal proof were unrun. The package gives no new κ or supplier admission.

## Open next questions

- Which prefix maximizes the physical component for repeated active chart factors?
- Can a signed caller stage realize the local extremum under its entrance correlations?

- [#7709](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7709) gives the normalized scalar maximum. Its extremizing location also maximizes the physical component under this input contract.
- [#7708](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7708) recodes the role-1256 graph. Its coefficients and prefixes change.
- [#7719](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7719) checks the recoded bank bases from #7708 against their parent.
- [#7712](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7712) splits three helpers on the recoded graph.
- [#7713](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7713) changes the helper interface on the recoded graph.
